name: malformed
description:
Every shape the parser must survive without losing the rest of the page, since no recorded response for this API exists to pin the real one down.

A null id is skipped rather than given a synthetic one. A bare string where an object is documented is dropped by the row reader. group arrives as a string instead of an object, normalizedProperties as a string instead of a list, and tags as a bare string instead of a list of objects: none of the three may abort the run, and the tag still survives because a bare string is accepted as a tag value. isDevice arrives as the string "false", which still means component. ip and mac arrive as lists on the last device even though both are documented singular: the link-local address in that list is dropped, and the second MAC becomes a second interface rather than being discarded.

The loopback device is the record-level loopback assertion the invariant cannot make: 127.0.0.1 with the name "localhost" leaves nothing to correlate on, so the record is skipped outright rather than imported as a nameless, addressless stub.

The vulnerability response arrives wrapped in an object rather than as the bare array Cisco's client expects. Updated when the documented vulnerability schema was applied: a finding that names no usable CVE is no longer dropped, because a Cisco advisory with cve null still carries a title, a CVSS and a solution and is a real finding. CVE-20-1 is too malformed to assert as Vulnerability.cve, which is validated and would fail the whole record, so that finding imports under its title with cve unset; the identifier survives as the cve_raw attribute. The third row carries no cve at all and a CVSS that arrived as a string rather than the documented double. All three import, and only the fourth row -- no cve, no id, no title, so nothing to key a finding on that would reconcile against itself on the next poll -- is skipped, along with the bare string that is not an object at all.

results: a bare string where a finding is documented

json: a bare string where an object is documented
